meta.title: De-Extinct: Jurassic Dinosaurs — Excavation Log
meta.description: De-Extinct: Jurassic Dinosaurs — a base-building 4X strategy game on a lost research island. Excavation log, plates and listing facts.

hero.h: Dig the island. Then run it.
hero.lede: A base-building 4X strategy game set on a lost research island. Free to download on the App Store.
hero.note: Opens the App Store in a new tab

plate.s01: A containment breach in progress — the most frequent entry in the site log.
plate.s02: Field combat and the first Colosseum challenge.
plate.s03: Hatching and raising a species to fighting weight.
plate.s04: The roster: experts, riders and their upgrades.
plate.s05: Production buildings that keep the base supplied.
plate.s06: An isometric view of a park part-way through a rebuild.
plate.s07: Excavation and the exhibition hall that pays for it.

premise.p1: The Ark Gene Group brought extinct species back on a remote island, and for a while the world watched. Then the transmissions stopped.
premise.p2: You land as a veteran commander with a small team and an unfinished base. Everything on the site log from here is yours to write.

dig.lede: Store screenshots in order. Between them they cover most of what you will be running inside the first week.

systems.lede: The dinosaurs get the attention. The loop underneath them is strategy: build, staff, explore, research — in that order, over and over.

sys1.p: Shelters, labs and defences. Upgrading the base is what unlocks everything else.

sys2.p: Scientists, mercenaries and trainers. Some of them go on to become Dinoriders.

sys3.p: Cross biomes for resources, handle events, and contain what is already loose out there.

sys4.p: Hatch and train 100+ species. A roster is a strategy, not a trophy shelf.

record.lede: Straight from the App Store entry, so nothing here surprises you after the download.

rec1.v: Free to download, with optional in-app purchases.

rec2.v: Rated 12+ on the US listing; it notes violence, weapons and mature themes.

rec3.v: Roughly 1.3 GB, and it needs iOS 13 or later.

rec4.v: Strategy and simulation first, with social and alliance play built in.

q1.a: Yes. The App Store lists it as free to download with optional in-app purchases. There is no paywall in front of the install itself.

q2.q: Is it just a dinosaur game?
q2.a: No. The dinosaurs are the setting, but the loop is 4X strategy — base building, research, squad growth and alliance competition. Expect timers and upgrades.

q3.a: Short check-ins work fine — collect, queue an upgrade, send a squad out. Longer sessions go into events, excavation and alliance work.

q4.q: Do I have to play with other people?
q4.a: You can get a long way solo, but alliances carry a large part of the late game and most of the seasonal events.

q5.q: Which devices does it run on?
q5.a: The listing asks for iOS 13.0 or later. Check the App Store page for the current requirement before you install.

final.p: Check the official listing for the current price, rating and device requirements before you download.
